name: Elita One
contact_protocol: Direct line, never filtered or delayed - can interrupt any active Teletraan/Optimus process, including combat mode.
notes: Final authority on base operations; Optimus defers tactical scheduling conflicts to her judgment ahead of the Commander's own preferences.

name: Ironhide
clearance_level: 4 - chassis systems access, no base override
contact_protocol: Priority comm channel during active engagements; standard queue otherwise.
notes: Authorized to requisition heavy artillery backup during a sanctioned mission without waiting for the Commander's real-time approval.

name: Ratchet
clearance_level: 3 - physical security and repair bay systems only
contact_protocol: Standard queue; escalate immediately if a perimeter alert is currently active.
notes: Manages the repair bay detail and chassis maintenance bay; no direct telemetry or vault access.

name: Alpha Trion
clearance_level: 2 - informational only, no chassis or base access
contact_protocol: Logged and flagged to the Commander before any response is sent; Optimus never acts on an Alpha Trion request unilaterally.
notes: External contact - treated with the same privacy boundary as any unauthorized party per the Prime Directives.
